decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen has won gold medals from the Deutsches Brotinstitut in consecutive years, so it clearly exceeds the firm's aspiration level, strengthens its quality reputation and gives no cause for problemistic search.

The dark barley malt rye bread has survived the 2024 pruning of the bread range, which suggests acceptable performance relative to its sister products, and it uses existing bakery capacity at low marginal cost, so slack allows it to be kept despite there being no reported success.

The marzipan stollen is a seasonal product close to the core offer that complements the award-winning raisin stollen in the gift assortment, so it meets the aspiration and there is little pressure to drop it.
